scope: Development after opening the original six UAE photo references. The 13 further wordings use the same four positive photographs. This is wording and integration coverage, not a new-image accuracy estimate.
positive_definition: One selectable point inside the previously frozen polygon, no immediate proposal or save token, passenger selection and separate confirmation. There is no ground-truth claim about stopping law, free space in metres, movement or an entire parking-bay footprint.

method.interior_points: The original Mask2Former map, existing same-frame Task 1 tracks, connected pavement and the source-bound 8B OPEN verdict on the full photo and crop corroborate the selected ground. Another registered source uses a specifically measured two-approach kerb recess and nearby pictured greenery/sign, with no 8B vacancy claim.
method.public_gallery: Existing public point observations have a single wide-view vacancy verdict. Each accepted public point marker also fits entirely inside one independently authenticated full-photo + crop BAY footprint that meets the existing vehicle size and connected-road gates. The candidate is withheld when either view or footprint is missing.
method.language: Names must match a legible phrase in a separate photo band, colours belong to the measured sign or named vehicle, and optional materials or palm species are disclosed as unverified. Mandatory legality, fare, travel-lane and unmatched referent instructions produce no alternative.

endpoint: Ordinary passenger submit, selection and explicit confirmation on the built app (no hosted calls for these six originals). Timings include local session opening and completion polling; they are a single run on this machine.

regression_tests.scope: Focused alternative language, signed observations, existing painted bays, local surfaces and native destinations. OpenCV bounded to one thread for the run. A prior run sharing memory with the model returned one allocation failure; all 61 including the added public eligibility regression passed on repeat.
